# Qingyu'Blog

> 零后端依赖的轻量博客系统，原生 HTML/CSS/JS + Cloudflare Workers/D1。支持文章、评论、标签、归档、后台写作、Smoji 表情、多语言切换。
> A lightweight blog system with no framework and no build step — vanilla HTML/CSS/JS plus Cloudflare Workers/D1. Posts, comments, tags, archive, an in-browser editor, Smoji emoji and a multilingual UI.

## 关键页面 / Key pages

- [首页 / Home](/)
- [归档 / Archive](/archive)
- [标签 / Tags](/tags)
- [关于 / About](/about)
- [文章 / Posts](/posts/)
- [后台 / Admin](/admin)

## 功能与说明 / Features

- 文章编辑器内置表情选择器，发表后正文、评论、留言板均可插入 Smoji 表情。 / A Smoji emoji picker is built into the editor; emoji can also be inserted in post bodies, comments and the guestbook.
- 顶部与底部导航、友情链接可在后台「设置」中维护，改动即时生效。 / Header and footer navigation plus friend links are maintained in the admin settings and take effect immediately.
- 支持简体中文、English、日本語、한국어、हिन्दी 多语言界面。 / The UI ships in Simplified Chinese, English, 日本語, 한국어 and हिन्दी.
- 文章列表支持分页与标签筛选；评论与留言板带审核与 AI 辅助能力。 / The post list supports pagination and tag filtering; comments and the guestbook support moderation and optional AI assistance.
- 本地 `file://` 双击 `public/index.html` 即可离线预览，无需构建。 / Opening `public/index.html` directly from disk (`file://`) works offline — no build step required.

## 技术栈 / Tech stack

- 前端：原生 HTML / CSS / JavaScript（无框架、无构建步骤） / Frontend: vanilla HTML / CSS / JavaScript (no framework, no build step)
- 后端：Cloudflare Workers / Pages Functions + D1 / KV / Backend: Cloudflare Workers / Pages Functions + D1 / KV
- 数据：文章、评论、留言、设置均持久化到 Cloudflare D1 / Data: posts, comments, guestbook entries and settings all persist in Cloudflare D1
